item.title: Jensen Huang Resigns From Nvidia After Affairs
item.description: The chief executive has been under scrutiny for an affair with a woman said to be a Chinese spy, as well as for a relationship with a subordinate at his A.I. chip company. Nvidia’s finance chief, Colette Kress, was named interim leader.

item.media:description: Few Silicon Valley executives have been as synonymous with their companies as Jensen Huang, the co-founder and chief executive of Nvidia.
